book.name: LUCAS
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ LUCAS

content: Spitzc'ubail Jesús

Ja' yet lalan to sajbi yet domingo, jun babel c'u yul semana, jix to eb ix bey jix bet muji can octoj smimanil Jesús tu'. Jix yi'toj wan ambal suk'uk'i sab eb jix swa'ne eb ix tu'. Ey pax wan xa eb ix jix to yetoj eb.
Ja' yet jix apni eb, jix yilon eb tol elnaj xa jun ch'en ey oc smajil bey jix muji Jesús tu'.
Jix octoj eb yul ch'en, catu' jix yilon eb, c'am xa smimanil naj Kaawil Jesús tu' ey ec' titu'.
Caw jix q'uey a sc'ul eb yiloni. Jix yilon eb ey ec' cawan ángel jaxca yili winaj, linan oc eb bey sc'atan eb. Chi tzejeji yili spichil eb ángel tu'.
Yuxan, caw chi xiw eb ix, catu' jix ey t'anan eb sat tx'otx'. Jix yalon eb ángel tu' tet eb ix jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yuxan ja' bey chi muji eb camnaj ti' che sey naj tol iquis xa?
C'am xa naj ey ec' titi'. Jix pitzc'u a naj. Na' wej tej tzet jix yal can e ex, yet ey ec' bey Galilea.

Jix yal can oj tol ja' Ak'bil Yopiso yu Dios xol eb je yet animail, sowalil oj ak'le yul sk'ab eb penawom, catu' oj ale oc yin culus, jix yaloni. Ja' yet yoxial, catu' oj pitzc'u a oj, ẍi jix yalon can e ex, ẍi eb tet eb ix.
Catu' jix sna'ontej eb ix tzet albil can tet eb yu Jesús.
Catu' jix paxtoj eb. Jix to yalon eb jun sk'aneal ti' tet eb jusluc'wan ẍejab Jesús, c'al tet masanil eb scuywom.
Ja' ix María Magdalena, Juana, yetoj María xutx Jacobo, ja' eb jix bet alon wan k'ane tu'. Ey pax wan xa eb ix ix ey ec' yetoj eb.
Pero ja' eb ẍejab tu', tu' c'al chi yal eb ix sna'on eb. Ma ẍa' eb yabe.

Pero ja' naj Pedro, jix a linan naj. Jix yak'on ani sto bey ch'en ch'en tu'. Jix apni c'al catu' jix yilon octoj yul ch'en ch'en tu'. Asanxane an pichile ey can xojli. Catu' jix paxtej. Caw jix q'uey a sc'ul naj yin wan jix yil tu'.
Jix X'ox A Sba Jesús Yul Be
Ja' yet jun c'ual tu', ey cawan eb scuywom lalan sto yul be chi apni Emaús. Ja' jun conob tu', ey mi oxeb oj legua snan xol yetoj Jerusalén.
Ja' yet lalan sbey eb tu', lalan yalon eb yu tzet jix yun tu'.
Ja' yet lalan c'al yalontenen wan tu' eb, jix apni Jesús sc'atan eb. Catu' junne xa c'al chi ec' eb yetoj naj.
Chi moyi a sat eb yu, yet watx' c'am chi yotane el eb ta tol ja' naj.
Jix sk'anlen Jesús tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yetal che yala, yet chex bey ti'? ¿Tzet yuxan caw chex cusi? ẍi tet eb.
Jix tak'wi jun chi yij Cleofas tet naj: —Yotaj masanil ánima tzet jix yun bey Jerusalén yet cabi-oxi ti'. Jal jaach, ¿tumi c'am cha wab nioj? Pero ilala, jix jaach ec' pax titu', ẍi eb tet Jesús.

¿Tzet jix yun titu' xin? ẍi Jesús tu' tet eb. —Ey jun a Nazaret, chi yij Jesús, caw ẍejab Dios ye naj. Ja' tzet jix el swa'neni c'al tzet jix el yaloni caw miman yel oc apnoj yul sat Dios yetoj yul sat eb ánima masanil.
Pero ja' eb yaaw yak'omal xaambal tet Dios, yetoj eb yaaw ye cu xol jix aon oc yul sk'ab camich. Yuxan jix yaon oc yin culus.
Ja' ton jun tu' chi kaoc yip oj cu c'ul, tzet utbil tol oj cu colcha el jaon Israel jon ti' yu. Pero ja' tinani', oxi tax jix yun wan tu'.
Ey wan eb ix ketbi jon jix q'uey a cu c'ul yu, yet jix kaben on, ja' yet jix sajbi, jix bet yilon ch'en ch'en eb bey jix bet muji can octoj smimanil Jesús tu'.
Ja' yet jix yilon eb tol man xa ey oj ec' smimanil tu', jix to eb yalon e on, tzet utbil tol jaxca weyiche jix yute yilon wan ángel eb. Jix yalon eb ángel tu' tet eb, tol iquis naj.
Jix c'al lawi tu' xin, ey wan eb ketbi jix bet ilon oj. Jaxca c'al yalon eb ix ix tu', quey tu' jix yute yilon eb. Pero ma yil yin Jesús eb, ẍi eb tet Jesús.
Yuxan jix yal Jesús tet eb jaxca ti': —Jaexti', jaxca tol c'am nioj je na'bal. Caw c'am che yaoc yin je c'ul jantaj tzet albil can yu eb ẍejab Dios peyxa.
Ja' Cristo sowalil ton t'inan yaben sya'il wan tu' yet c'am to chi oc Yaawilal, ẍi Jesús tet eb.

Catu' jix ẍa'on el yich yalon tet eb, beytaj c'al ey oc sk'aneal yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj. Jix ẍa'ontej yich yalon tzettaj tz'ibebil can yu naj Moisés. Jix yalon pax tej tzet tz'ibebil can yu eb ẍejab Dios peyxa.
Ja' yet jix apni eb bey jun conob bey lalan sto eb tu', ian palan c'al yec' el Jesús tu'.
Pero jix yak'on yip eb smitx'on oc tucan oj. Jix yalon eb tet jaxca ti': —Canan ketoj, ilala, lalan yey c'u, lalan xa sk'ejbi, ẍi eb tet Jesús. Ja' yet jix octoj yul na tu', jix can titu' yetoj eb.
Ja' yet jix ey chotan yin meẍa yetoj eb, jix yi'on a jun ixim pan, catu' jix yalon yu diosalil tet Dios yu. Catu' jix ẍi'on ec' xol eb tu'.
Ja' yet jix yun jun tu', jaxca tol jix jajcha sat eb. Catu' jix yilon oc eb, tol ja' Jesús. Pero jix yesnen q'uey sba. Jix yilontej eb, c'am xa mac txequel.
Catu' jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Yel toni, caw jix jul cu na'bal yet jix yalon e on yul be, yet jix yak'on na'cha el ku, tzettaj chi yal yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj, ẍi eb.
Jix to xa c'al eb bey Jerusalén yet jun txolan tu', jix il-le yin eb jusluc'wan ẍejab Jesús titu' yu eb, yetoj wan xa eb yetbi eb. Yaman ec' eb titu'.
Jix yalon eb tu' tet eb cawan tu' jaxca ti': —Caw yel jix pitzc'u a naj Kaawil junel xa. Jix x'ox sba tet naj Simón ti', ẍi eb.
Catu' jix yalontej eb cawan tu' tzet jix yun eb yul-laj be. Jix yalon pax tej eb tzet jix yun sna'cha el Jesús yu eb, yet jix ẍi'on ec' ixim pan.
Jix X'ox A Sba Jesús Tet Eb Scuywom
Lalan to yalon eb wan tu', jix yilontej eb, ey xa ec' Jesús snan xol eb. Catu' jix yalon jaxca ti': —Ey ojab watx' c'ulal snan je xol, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jal eb, tu' c'al chi xiw eb catu' caw chi q'uey a sc'ul eb. Ja' sna'on eb tol lab jun chi yil eb tu'.
Pero jix yal tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yuxan tu' c'al chi somcha el je c'ul yet chin je yiloni? ¿Tzet yuxan ey je caab c'ulal win an?

Ilala, il wej jin k'ab c'al wajan ti' an. Jain toni, mitx' jin wej an. Chi cam je yoc t'anan win an. Ja' junoj lab, toj ey ẍi'beal, toj ey sbajil bey watx' chex oc mitx'an yin jaxca wet ti' an, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix lawi yalon jun tu', jix x'oxon sk'ab tet eb tu', c'al yajan.
Cax c'al chi tzala a eb, pero ja'c'ala' ian ma yaoc eb yin sc'ul, yutol tu' c'al chi q'uey a sc'ul eb. Yuxan jix yal pax tet eb jaxca ti': —¿C'am mi nioj tzet watx' chin lo' titi'? ẍi naj tet eb.
Yuxan jix yak' nioj bolbil pescado eb tet, [c'al nian yal awcab].
Jix ẍa'on tu' catu' jix slo'on sattaj eb.

Yet jix lawi slo'oni, jix yalon pax tet eb jaxca ti': —Ja' tinani', jix yun jaxca jix yun walon e ex yet jix jin ec' je yetoj. Ilala, jix wal e ex tol sowalil oj yun jantaj tzet yetal tz'ibebil can wu an yul sley Moisés, yetoj tzet tz'ibebil can yu eb ẍejab Dios, yetoj wan chi alon win an yul libro Salmo, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Catu' jix yak'on jajcha sna'bal eb, yet watx' chi na'cha el yu eb, tzet tz'ibebil can yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can tu'.
Yuxan jix yal tet eb jaxca ti' junel xa: —Ja' yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can jin k'aneal, jain Cristo jin ti' an, tol sowalil oj jin cam oj, yoxial tu', catu' chin pitzc'u pax a xol eb camnaj.

Yetoj pax oj, sowalil oj al-le el jin k'aneal xol ánima bey jun jun nación. Oj al-le el xol eb tol sowalil chi sna' sba sc'ul eb yin spenail, yet watx' chi jo'le q'uey spenail eb tu' yiban. Ja' bey Jerusalén ti' oj baboj al-le el jin k'aneal, catu' oj sajlemtoj bey jun jun conob.
Jaexti', oj je yak' je ba testigoal yin wan ti'.
Yak'naj can Dios sti', tol ey jun oj eyol e ex. Ja' ton jun tu', oj toj jin chejab oj. Pero echbane wej bey Jerusalén ti', masanta' c'al che cha' je yip oj ale eytej satcan, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix Pax A Jesús Satcan
Catu' jix yi'ontoj eb scuywom bey scawilal conob Betania. Jix sq'uetxba a sk'ab titu', catu' jix sk'anon swatx' c'ulal Dios yiban eb.
Lalan to sk'anon swatx' c'ulal Dios tu', catu' jix i'le atoj satcan, catu' jix can can eb yu.
Jix lawi yi'on ey sba eb tet, catu' jix meltzo eb yin tzala c'ulalil bey Jerusalén.
Jun jun c'al c'u chi bet eb bey stemplo Dios. Jix bet yalon watx' k'ane eb tet Dios. Amén.
